usage: Used for a public or school sports building, especially a place with indoor courts or training space.
Commonly comes after a place name, like naming a venue or facility; it sounds natural in everyday Hong Kong Cantonese.
Can refer to the building itself, not the activity; for the activity, Cantonese often uses other words instead.
A very common, neutral word for learners; good to use when talking about community facilities, schools, and sports venues.
